title: Accurate profile connection totals and independent collaboration availability
summary: Use accepted relationships with active peers for profile/network totals. Persist an owner-controlled availability boolean independently of roles and capacity; preserve drafts, explicit false, privacy and concurrency checks. Remove paused candidates' role boost without hiding them from networking.
dataSourcesChanged: connections accepted records and active peer profiles
concurrencyRisk: The existing expectedUpdatedAt compare-and-update protects profile writes. Quick toggles submit only availability, lock repeated clicks, and roll back on failure. Migration backfills only NULL availability values, retaining explicit false on replay.

logs: Existing profile save and connection mutation failures

rollback.strategy: Revert application changes while retaining the additive availability column and repaired counters. Do not undo reconciliation or replay old counter migrations.
validation: Compare accepted relationship counts with profile totals
Verify role preference lists remain saved while paused

commands: DATABASE_URL_FRESH=<disposable> node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/db/profile-connection-stats.test.ts tests/db/profile-preferences.test.ts tests/db/connections-paging.test.ts
